description: The STREAM project publishes time-stamped active and reactive power from a hybrid photovoltaic and community battery installation at its Spanish pilot site. Zenodo lists one public CSV, about 24 KB, under CC BY 4.0. The provider identifies the fields as Time, Active power and Reactive power and says the installation supported a local flexibility-market demonstration. A modeller could compare simulated inverter or battery dispatch against this observed pilot series, or use it to test low-voltage congestion scenarios. The file is a site-specific demonstration record, not a general Spanish grid load curve. The own page does not specify measurement units, sign convention, sampling interval, calendar coverage or how battery and PV contributions are separated. Those gaps limit direct calibration without inspecting the CSV and technical pilot documentation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this power-series deposit. The CSV was not downloaded, so values, timestamp quality and completeness remain unverified.
name: STREAM ES-UC.04.01 Active and reactive power of the hybrid PV + community BESS installation - Spanish pilot site
